housing: Cincinnati has a lot of older brick housing: two- and three-family homes, Italianate row buildings in Over-the-Rhine, and older houses split into apartments near the University of Cincinnati.

tenantHelp.name: Legal Aid Society of Southwest Ohio
tenantHelp.what: free legal help for low-income renters

climate: Test the furnace, check older windows for drafts and look for water in the basement; winters are cold and many buildings are old.
fact: Cincinnati also caps residential late fees at $50 or 5% of monthly rent, whichever is greater.
